method.model: Bradley-Terry strengths fit by MM iteration on non-mirror games
method.bt_regulariser: 1 virtual win + 1 virtual loss vs an average opponent (strength 1 = geometric mean, renormalised every MM step)
method.strength_scale: geometric mean of strengths = 1; expected(a beats b) = s_a / (s_a + s_b)
method.strength_interval: 95% interval from the observed Fisher information of the regularised likelihood, for log-strength relative to the field mean
method.strength_gate: strength, its interval, expected_vs_field and every pair's expected are null when a commander has fewer than 20 non-mirror games
method.strength_use: model inputs, not a ranking: the commander list is alphabetical; show the mirror-free record with its interval instead
method.estimate: posterior mean of Beta(k*expected + wins, k*(1-expected) + losses)
method.estimate_gate: est, lo, hi and favored are null below 10 games (record only)
method.favored: set only when the posterior interval excludes 0.5 and the raw record points the same way

evidence.counter: n >= 20, favored set, the favored side beats the strength expectation by more than 0.02 (interval bound), |est - 0.5| >= 0.1
evidence.lean: favored set (interval excludes 0.5 and the raw record agrees), not a counter

evidence_labels.even: Even as far as we can tell

method.unplayed_pairs: omitted (no row means no recorded games)
method.raw_wr_gate: raw_wr is null below 20 games (wins and n always present)
method.consistent_with_strength: pairs with n >= 20 whose raw 95% Wilson interval contains the strength-model expectation
